detailZh: 西班牙大奖赛：基米·安东内利在马德里练习赛中力压法拉利，阿尔维德·林德布拉德在充满挑战的马德林赛道遭遇F1首撞
基米·安东内利在二练中领先法拉利的查尔斯·勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿做出最快圈速；阿尔维德·林德布拉德成为首位在马德里新赛道撞车的F1车手；周六下午3点可在天空体育 F1直播观看全新马德林赛道的西班牙大奖赛排位赛
西班牙大奖赛周五练习赛集锦
世界锦标赛领先者基米·安东内利在F1西班牙大奖赛马德里新赛道的首日运行中做出最快圈速，而马德林赛道极具挑战性的特点也因英国新秀阿尔维德·林德布拉德的严重撞车而显露无遗。
在当天第一节练习赛中被梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔压制后，安东内利在二练中做出1:33.662的更快圈速，以略多于0.1秒的优势力压法拉利双雄查尔斯·勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿。
成绩表进一步证明了安东内利极高的自信心，上周末他在意大利大奖赛上从第19位发车赢得主场胜利，将他在积分榜上对拉塞尔的领先优势扩大到66分，2026赛季还剩10站比赛。

从周五练习赛的情况来看，梅赛德斯和法拉利实力接近，可能在周六排位赛中上演激动人心的杆位争夺，西班牙首都充满巨大兴奋，因为F1自1981年以来首次重返该城市。
阿尔维德·林德布拉德在二练13号弯严重撞车，引发马德林赛道首次红旗
许多人此前预测周五——以及整个周末剩余时间——会出现大量红旗，因为这条赛道狭窄且极具惩罚性，所有车手都从未在此比赛过。
虽然周五的F2和F3比赛中出现了多次撞车和红旗，但F1车手展现了他们的高超水平，在一练中避免了任何重大事故，然而林德布拉德在二练刚过半程后便遭遇了麻烦。
这位19岁车手表现令人印象深刻，刚刚升至第四位，但在下一圈飞驰圈中推得太猛，在13号弯失控，高速旋转撞向护栏。
阿尔维德·林德布拉德在周五练习赛撞车后形容马德林赛道“不是一条容易的赛道”。
林德布拉德表示：“这不是一条容易的赛道。我们都在努力寻找极限。这对我们所有人来说都是新的。只是犯了个小错误，在13号弯做得过头了。很遗憾。我向机械师和车队道歉。今晚他们要多干活了。”
“但从大局来看，这是不错的一天。我们非常快。我凭实力跑到第四，距离第一只有0.2秒，这非常强。”
“对车队进入明天充满信心。我只专注于重置，试着把它抛在脑后，吸取所有好的经验。”
F2的塔萨纳波尔·因特拉普瓦萨克在赛车起火后安然走开！
超过10分钟的中断结束了当时正在进行的排位赛模拟，确保了安东内利在成绩表榜首的位置。
拉塞尔在似乎难以优化赛车调校后排名第五，但仍力压红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘和迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。
“第一次驾驶这条赛道很有趣，”拉塞尔说。“驾驶新赛道总是很棒的体验。”
“一练是强劲的一节。二练我们做了一些调校改动，效果不太好，所以我们可能会改回去。到目前为止一切顺利。”
车手们在周五练习赛后分享对马德林赛道的第一印象。
卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯因变速箱故障仅跑两圈便退出本节，未能做出时间。
鉴于诺里斯在安东内利蒙扎夺冠前取得背靠背胜利，迈凯伦本被预期在马德里具有竞争力，但周五几乎没有证据表明这一点。
虽然诺里斯近期总体比皮亚斯特里更快，但在新赛道损失整个一节练习赛将使这位英国车手在进入周六时处于不利位置。

detailEn: Spanish GP: Kimi Antonelli edges Ferrari in Madrid practice as Arvid Lindblad suffers first F1 crash at challenging Madring circuit

Kimi Antonelli fastest from Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton in Practice Two; Arvid Lindblad first F1 driver to crash at new Madrid track; watch Spanish GP Qualifying from the all-new Madring circuit live on Sky Sports F1 at 3pm on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Spanish Grand Prix

World championship leader Kimi Antonelli was fastest on Formula 1's first day of running at the Spanish Grand Prix's new Madrid circuit as the hugely challenging nature of the Madring was exhibited by a big crash for British rookie Arvid Lindblad.

After being outpaced by his Mercedes team-mate George Russell in the day's first session, Antonelli produced a quicker time of 1:33.662 in Practice Two to edge out Ferrari duo Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton by little more than a tenth of a second.

The timesheet was further evidence of Antonelli's sky-high confidence, which was elevated by a stunning victory at the Italian Grand Prix last weekend as he won his home race from 19th on the grid to move 66 points clear of Russell at the top of the standings with 10 rounds of the 2026 season remaining.

On the evidence of Friday's sessions, Mercedes and Ferrari are closely matched and could deliver an exciting pole contest in qualifying on Saturday, with huge excitement in the Spanish capital as F1 returns to the city for the first time since 1981.
Arvid Lindblad brought out the first red flag at the Madring track after this heavy crash on turn 13 during second practice
Many had predicted a high number of red flags on Friday - and throughout the rest of the weekend - due to the tight and punishing nature of a circuit that the field have never raced at before.

While there were several crashes and red flags in Friday's F2 and F3 sessions, the F1 drivers showed their excellence to avoid any major incidents in first practice, but it was Lindblad who came unstuck just beyond the halfway point of Practice Two.
The 19-year-old was driving impressively and had just elevated himself to fourth when he pushed too hard on his next flying lap, losing control at Turn 13 and spinning into the barrier at high speed.
Arvid Lindblad describes the Madring circuit as 'not an easy track' following his crash during Friday's practice.

Lindblad said: "It's not an easy track. We are all pushing to find the limits. It's new for all of us. Just made a bit of a mistake and overdid it in Turn 13. A shame. I apologise to the mechanics and the team. It's extra work for them tonight.
"But looking at the big picture, it's been a good day. We are very fast. I was running P4 on merit and was only two tenths from P1 which is really strong.
"A lot of confidence in the team going into tomorrow. I'm just focused on resetting and trying to block it out and taking all the good learnings."
F2's Tasanapol Inthraphuvasak walks away after his car went up in flames!
A delay of just over 10 minutes put an end to the qualifying simulations that had been taking place at that stage, securing Antonelli's position at the top of the timesheet.
Russell was fifth after appearing to struggle to optimise his setup, but still managed to edge out Red Bull's Max Verstappen and McLaren's Oscar Piastri.
"It was fun to drive the track for the first time," Russell said. "It's always a great experience driving a new circuit.
"FP1 was a strong session. FP2 we made some setup changes which weren't quite as good, so we will probably revert back on that. So far so good."
Drivers share their first thoughts of the Madring circuit after friday's practice.
Reigning world champion Lando Norris was unable to set a time after a gearbox failure took him out of the session after just two laps.
McLaren were expected to be competitive in Madrid given Norris had claimed back-to-back victories before Antonelli's win in Monza, but there was little evidence of that on Friday.
While Norris has generally been quicker than Piastri recently, losing an entire session at a new circuit will put the Brit on the back foot going into Saturday.

迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里位列第四，而红牛似乎已退出杆位争夺，马克斯·维斯塔潘落后领先圈速0.351秒，但周六晚9点（晚8点开始预热）的天空体育F1直播排位赛前，前排似乎确实有三支车队在争夺。
无论维斯塔潘在排位赛中表现如何，他都不能从杆位起步，因为他和小红牛车队的利亚姆·劳森因周五第二节练习中相撞而被罚退一个发车位。
赛会干事称该事件“不可接受”，两位车手都承认这次碰撞“没有必要且笨拙”。
在墨西哥城大奖赛第二节自由练习中，小红牛的利亚姆·劳森与红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘发生接触，这次碰撞最终导致两位车手都收到发车位罚单。
周六最后一节练习赛前又发生了更多戏剧性事件，哈斯车队做出令人震惊的决定，用替补车手平川亮替换埃斯特班·奥康，参加本周末剩余的比赛。
车队没有给出替换奥康的原因，但确认这位法国车手并未患病。
哈斯最近确认，奥康将在本赛季结束后离开车队，他在美国老板旗下的这支车队效力了两年，巴西年轻车手拉斐尔·卡马拉已签约作为他的替代者。
勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军平川亮在过去两年中多次参加哈斯车队的练习环节，在最后一次练习中排名第19，落后队友奥利弗·贝尔曼0.6秒。

detailEn: Mexico City GP: Lando Norris pips Kimi Antonelli in final practice to set up thrilling Mexico qualifying

Lando Norris and Kimi Antonelli were separated by just 0.001s at the top of the timesheet in final practice for the Mexico City Grand Prix; watch qualifying later at 9pm with Sunday's race at 8pm (build-up from 6.30pm), live on Sky Sports F1

Sky Sports F1's David Croft and Karun Chandok discuss Esteban Ocon being replaced by Haas for the Mexico City GP, Liam Lawson and Max Verstappen being handed a grid penalty for their P2 collision and Isack Hajar's paddock altercation with a fan
McLaren's Lando Norris pipped Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli by 0.001s in final practice for the Mexico City Grand Prix to set up a thrilling qualifying.
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc had topped both of Friday's practice sessions but McLaren and Mercedes showed their hand to outpace the Monegasque driver by one tenth of a second.
Antonelli is likely to become world champion in Sunday's race as he only needs a top-nine finish to secure the Formula 1 drivers' title.

McLaren's Oscar Piastri was fourth while Red Bull appear to be out of the pole position battle as Max Verstappen was 0.351s off the pace, but there seems to be a genuine three-team fight at the front for qualifying later on Saturday at 9pm (build-up from 8pm), live on Sky Sports F1.
Regardless of what he does in qualifying, Verstappen cannot start on pole position as he and Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson have a one-grid place penalty for colliding in second practice on Friday.
The stewards called the incident "unacceptable", with both drivers admitting the clash was "unnecessary and clumsy".
Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson and Red Bull's Max Verstappen make contact during FP2 at the Mexico City GP - the clash would eventually lead to both drivers receiving a grid penalty
More drama took place before final practice on Saturday as Haas made the shock decision to replace Esteban Ocon with reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa for the remainder of the weekend.
The team provided no reason for replacing Ocon, but confirmed the Frenchman was not suffering from illness.
Haas recently confirmed that Ocon will be leaving the team at the end of this season after two years with the American-owned squad, with Brazilian youngster Rafael Camara signed as his replacement.
Hirakwa, a 24 Hours of Le Mans winner, has taken part in several practice sessions for Haas over the last two years and was 19th in final practice, six tenths down on team-mate Oliver Bearman.

奥康在第二次练习赛后以第13名完赛，在车队无线电中发泄了自己的不满，并且将不再参加本站比赛的任何环节，因为平川亮将在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道顶替他的发车位。
奥康质疑了车队在周五第二次练习赛中让他使用中性胎而非软胎的决定。
这位法国车手在被赛事工程师劳拉·穆勒告知其驾驶计划有变后，恳求道“别这样对我”。
哈斯车队最近确认，奥康将在本赛季结束后离开这支美国所有的车队，他已在队效力两年。
车队声明写道：“TGR哈斯F1车队储备车手平川亮将在本周末墨西哥城大奖赛的剩余赛程中替换埃斯特班·奥康，时间为10月31日星期六至11月1日星期日。”
“平川亮（32岁）曾随丰田GAZOO Racing两度赢得国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛冠军（2022年、2023年），并夺得勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军（2022年）。他于10月30日星期五在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道参加了第一节自由练习，这是他本赛季第三次驾驶VF-26赛车出战自由练习，最终位列全场第15名。”
“这位日本车手将在星期六的第三节自由练习和排位赛以及星期日的71圈大奖赛中与队友奥利·贝尔曼搭档——这将是平川亮的F1正赛首秀。”

detailEn: Esteban Ocon: Haas replace French driver with Ryo Hirakawa for remainder of Mexico City GP weekend without providing reason

Esteban Ocon will take no further part in the Mexico City GP, with Haas replacing French driver with Ryo Hirakawa; Haas gave no reason for Ocon's replacement; Ocon is leaving the team at the end of the season
Esteban Ocon has been replaced by Ryo Hirakawa at Haas for the remainder of the Mexico City Grand Prix.
The team provided no reason for replacing Ocon, but confirmed the Frenchman was not suffering from illness.

Ocon vented his frustrations on the team radio while finishing 13th following second practice and will take no further part in the race as Hirakawa will take his place on the grid at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodríguez.
Ocon questioned the team's decision to run him on the medium rather than soft tyre during second practice on Friday.
The Frenchman pleaded "don't do this to me" to his race engineer Laura Mueller after being informed of a change to his run-plan.
Haas recently confirmed that Ocon will be leaving the team at the end of this season after two years with the American-owned squad.
A team statement read: "TGR Haas F1 Team reserve driver Ryō Hirakawa will replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix, Saturday 31 October - Sunday 1 November.

"Hirakawa (32), a two-time winner of the FIA World Endurance Championship (2022, 2023) and 24 Hours of Le Mans Winner (2022) with Toyota GAZOO Racing, participated in FP1 at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday 30 October - his third free practice outing of the season driving the VF-26, finishing 15th overall.
"The Japanese driver will partner teammate Ollie Bearman through final practice and qualifying on Saturday and Sunday's 71-lap grand prix - Hirakawa's Formula 1 race debut."
